card.name: Trial descriptions in antipsychotic mortality warnings
card.fires_on: The word "largely" after "placebo-controlled trials (modal duration of 10 weeks)," in the antipsychotic dementia mortality warning. It also fires on the hyphen or space inside trial descriptions and names.

modes.label: Largely after trial duration
modes.description: The word "largely" right after the parenthetical trial duration in the boxed antipsychotic warning.

modes.description: A hyphen or gap inside a trial label or before a patient count, where the study design is being described.
